purpose: 성인 인간 캐릭터 10명 × 특별 보너스 이벤트 CG 5장면 (일상·커스텀 의상 — 비노골적, 기본 의상 아님). 원화 GPT Image 2 → 검수 → MiniMax H3 4.4초 루프.
content_rules: Tasteful and non-explicit. Adult characters only (ages 19-27). Standard beach swimwear, sportswear and everyday outfits in leisure/sport/daily contexts. Natural adult proportions, no suggestive posing, no nudity, no lingerie, no text/logo/watermark.

gym.camera: medium shot from the side or three-quarter

yoga.camera: low wide angle across the mat
